title: UN top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
caption:
The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya during a 2017 military campaign in northern Rakhine state, the first time the court has found a state responsible for genocide. Judges voted 9 to 6 and ordered Myanmar to allow the safe return of Rohingya, prosecute those responsible and pay compensation. The ruling is binding, but the court has no means to enforce it beyond the UN Security Council.
